programmes.d: The team investigates a fugitive diamond thief's murder. Rusty is in a tough spot when Mariana's brother Gus (RENE ROSADO) discovers his relationship with Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
The Major Crimes team searches for a professional baseball player's daughter who is missing, and the investigation leads them to the very limits of the justice system.
Sharon and the team track an unhinged killer making his own film, with his victims as the stars. A new romance finds wings.
A gun used in a murder is connected to the most troubling series of unsolved homicides in LAPD history. Captain Raydor and the rest of her division attempt to solve the mystery.
Sharon and Major Crimes rush to capitalize on a shocking discovery made in a church. Steph (JULIE ANN EMERY) and Sanchez's connection grows as they bond over lost loved ones.
With another victim found, Sharon focuses on former LAPD detective Mark Hickman (JASON GEDRICK). Fritz (JON TENNEY) and his team help the LAPD show up in force at a funeral.
More information pours in about victims from the past and how they tie to the murders of the present. Lt. Cooper (MALCOM-JAMAL WARNER) and Amy Sykes get caught in a gun fight.
In the gripping season finale, the threads of seven murders are tied together as the video wire on Reverend Price (TARIK LOWE) elicits admissions, narrowing the field of suspects.
In the season premiere, the Major Crimes squad investigates the mysterious disappearance of a teenage girl who vanished while volunteering at a homeless shelter.
Ari (guest start Rudolf Martin) continues to wreak havoc on the NCIS team as he uses its members as pawns in the game he is playing with Gibbs.

Under order from the Governor of Virginia, a skeptical Gibbs is forced to meet with a serial killer he helped to convict a decade before under the pretense that the killer will tell Gibbs where he hid missing bodies.
Gibbs and the team are called in when a recently deceased man is found encased in a Civil War-era tomb. The corpse is that of a missing Staff Sergeant who, according to Ducky, was buried alive.
When a petty officer is brutally gunned down on the freeway, Gibbs and the team discover that the officer had been living a double life.
Gibbs and the team investigate the murder of a Marine's wife that appears to have been broadcast over the Internet.
Gibbs and the team investigate when a 6-year-old boy informs NCIS his father has been kidnapped.
When the bodies of two assassins are delivered to NCIS from overseas, Tony and Ziva assume their identities undercover and engage in a sexy rendezvous at a luxury hotel in order to find their target.
When a portion of a female body is found at Quantico, the NCIS team investigates and is shocked to discover that all the forensic evidence points to Tony as the prime suspect.
The murder of a detective in the Sex Crimes unit leads Major Crimes into the world of "barely legal" porn. Rusty's biological mother (EVER CARRADINE) returns.

After an ISIS-related attack against a member of the U.S. Armed Services, the FBI asks for Captain Raydor's help in finding a terrorist.
While Flynn looks into purchasing a new home, Buzz continues to investigate the circumstances surrounding his father's murder.
Sanchez's application to become a foster parent is jeopardized by a gruesome murder after the Division finds a chopped up body burned to bits in the barbecue pit of an L.A. Park.
L.A.'s tourist industry is threatened when British tourists get attacked on their second honeymoon, and Rusty's biological mother tries to make peace with him over her pregnancy.
The Major Crimes Unit scrambles to find a disturbed killer, while Rusty pushes against the LAPD policy in order to find more evidence related to the murders of Buzz's father.
Lts. Andy Flynn and Mike Tao delve into the mysterious overdose of a young Hollywood star, while Rusty comes to a conclusion about how to handle his biological mother's pregnancy.
Major Crimes investigates a divorce attorney with angry clients when a jogger takes a fall, and Lt. Tao goes undercover. Plus, Buzz finds a complete print and identifies a suspect.
